evidence.title: GitHub - jal-co/ui: Open-source React component library. Polished, composable components for React and Tailwind CSS. Distributed via a shadcn-compatible registry. Never paywalled. · GitHub

name: jalco ui
summary: React components for docs, code and GitHub UIs, installed from a shadcn-compatible registry.
description: Polished, composable React components by Justin Levine for docs, dev-tool and marketing pages: code blocks, diff, JSON, log and request viewers, API reference and env tables, GitHub, npm, license and CI badges, buttons, charts and a stepper. Distributed through a shadcn-compatible registry (@jalco) with one-command installs; no wrapper package, server-component-first, styled with Tailwind CSS v4.
contains: 36 components across code, docs, GitHub, ecosystem, dev-tools and marketing groups
no npm package — components are copied as source via the shadcn CLI
65 shiki editor color themes for code and data components
server-component-first, built with React 19, Next.js 15 and Tailwind CSS v4
